mapper.insert: INSERT INTO `show` (name, description, category_id, poster_url, venue, status, create_time, update_time) VALUES (#{name}, #{description}, #{categoryId}, #{posterUrl}, #{venue}, #{status}, #{createTime}, #{updateTime})
mapper.update: UPDATE `show` SET name = #{name}, description = #{description}, category_id = #{categoryId}, poster_url = #{posterUrl}, venue = #{venue}, status = #{status}, update_time = #{updateTime} WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT id, name, description, category_id, poster_url, venue, status, create_time, update_time FROM `show` ORDER BY create_time DESC
SELECT id, name, description, category_id, poster_url, venue, status, create_time, update_time FROM `show` WHERE status = #{status} ORDER BY create_time DESC

SELECT s.id, s.name, s.description, s.category_id, s.poster_url, s.venue, s.status, s.create_time, s.update_time, c.name AS category_name FROM `show` s LEFT JOIN category c ON c.id = s.category_id WHERE s.id = #{id}

#{id}
